about: Ground truth for the 30 clusters the triage model judged, built from the Phase 2 findings (run 40686064885). real = the weakness exists as described and is reachable in the deployed app; fp = it does not exist as described, or the vulnerable code is not reachable at runtime; uncertain = could not be settled with reasonable effort (excluded from the confusion matrix and counted separately).
labelled_by: Claude (AI assistant), from code and lockfile evidence listed per label. Pending review by the student; change any label you disagree with and re-run metrics/score_triage.py.

labels.label: fp
labels.evidence: tar 6.2.1 sits under sqlite3/node_modules and is required only by sqlite3, node-gyp and cacache: native-module build tooling. The app never unpacks tar archives at runtime.

labels.label: real
labels.evidence: Direct dependency pinned to 0.4.0 and used by lib/insecurity.ts to sign and verify every session JWT; CVE-2015-9235 (verification bypass) is reachable by any client sending a token.

labels.label: uncertain
labels.evidence: lodash 2.4.2 is a private copy under sanitize-html; whether sanitize-html 1.4.2 calls defaultsDeep/template/merge with attacker data was not verified.

labels.evidence: crypto-js 3.3.0 is required only by pdfkit, which uses it for PDF encryption; order-confirmation PDFs are generated without a password, so the weak PBKDF2 path is not used.
